title: Variable bound for the adjacency formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The variable count of the CNF formula encoding adjacency for parameters $n$ and $s$ is at most twice the width of the configuration encoding, $2\,\mathrm{width}(n,s)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
replaced:
Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let
$n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The variable count of its adjacency formula is at most twice the
width $w(n,s)$ assigned to encodings of configurations for these parameters.
